title_en: Villa with Pool in Flowers Hill Residence!
description_en: Villa with pool for sale in Flowers Hill Residence! The villa has a construction area (net) of 278.2m2, a veranda + pool area of ​​56m2, a land area of ​​268m2 and a parking area (open) of 25m2. The 1st floor is organized into a studio, a bedroom, a toilet and a technical room. Floor 0 is organized in a living room, a separate kitchen with a cooking area, a toilet and a veranda + swimming pool. The 1st floor is organized into 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Flowers Residence offers a comfortable and quiet life very close to nature and clean air. For more information contact us!
